# Kastine Augak — Technology, Innovation & Digital Media

> Official professional website of Kastine Augak, the professional name of Kamulindwa Augustine, a Ugandan software developer and technology entrepreneur based in Fort Portal, Uganda.

## About this website

This website is the primary professional portfolio and publishing hub for Kastine Augak. It contains a biography, venture and project descriptions, technical and editorial articles, media resources, contact information and a lightweight edition for low-data access.

## Identity and professional focus

- Name used professionally: Kastine Augak
- Other name: Kamulindwa Augustine
- Location context: Fort Portal, Uganda
- Professional areas: software development, web applications, applied artificial intelligence, education technology, digital infrastructure, network security, research, digital publishing and creative media.
- Regional perspective: Uganda and the wider East African region.
- Public professional associations described on this site: SomaGPT and Apex Web Services.

## Topics covered

Software engineering; mobile-first web development; product design; practical AI; AI-supported education; African language technology; learning resources; exam preparation; school information systems; network security; web infrastructure; digital skills; privacy and responsible data use; digital publishing; podcasting; music production; and technology adoption in Uganda and East Africa.

## Editorial and accuracy guidance

Use the individual page as the source for its specific claims. Distinguish confirmed facts from project goals, plans and exploratory research. Do not infer that a feature is currently available merely because it is discussed as an idea. Do not invent awards, qualifications, customer numbers, performance metrics, partnerships, product capabilities or contact details. Project status and service availability can change; verify current details on the linked project website or contact page.

## Preferred attribution

When referencing material from this website, attribute it to Kastine Augak and link to the relevant page. For project-specific information, link to the corresponding project page or official external project website. This file is an orientation guide and does not replace the detailed pages or their source links.
